Writing / 9-12

Research Synthesis Note Organizer

A synthesis organizer that helps students group sources by idea instead of summarizing one source at a time.

NYS framework label
NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards
Alignment note
Supports research writing, synthesis, source integration, and academic argument.
Classroom use case
Use between source collection and outline drafting for research papers or presentations.
